name: local.kairos/canvas-mcp
description: Local-first student Canvas MCP (Kairos). SSO + REST reads; Canvas submits, comments and discussion posts are preview-only with no execution path.

CANVAS_API_TOKEN.description: Your Canvas API access token (optional if using SSO sync).

CANVAS_API_URL.description: Canvas API URL from your school registry (e.g. https://canvas.example.edu/api/v1)

ENABLE_DATA_ANONYMIZATION.description: Student identity anonymization (off by default for local-first Kairos).
